business_problem: Ensemble Health Partners helps ensure the financial health of healthcare organizations through data-driven revenue cycle managed services. To ensure that health systems are reimbursed for the services delivered to patients, Ensemble relies on complex payer and provider data to streamline interactions along the claims transaction journey.
solution_summary: Ensemble Health Partners built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Power BI. Ensemble Health Partners helps ensure the financial health of healthcare organizations through data-driven revenue cycle managed services. To ensure that health systems are reimbursed for the services delivered to patients, Ensemble relies on complex payer and provider data to streamline interactions along the claims transaction journey. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Power BI presents dashboards and reports to business users and planners.

data_flow: Source data is ingested into databricks, curated in Delta Lake tables, processed with Databricks compute and orchestration services, and exposed to downstream analytics and users. It connects with Power BI, push, API.
business_outcome: Since migrating EIQ to the Databricks Data + AI Platform, Ensemble has gained new insights and functionality to improve services at scale. Now, the company is moving faster with fewer resources, simple lakehouse architecture and access controls to become more data-driven with efficient results.
